items.prompt:
Which organisms break down dead plants and animals?
A) Decomposers
B) Rocks
C) The Sun
D) Clouds

steps: Decomposers break down dead material and waste.

items.prompt:
Plants take the matter they need from
A) animals only
B) the air, water, and soil
C) decomposers only
D) nowhere
items.answer: B) the air, water, and soil

steps: Plants take matter from their environment.

items.prompt:
Which is an example of a decomposer?
A) A deer
B) A mushroom
C) An oak tree
D) A rock

The movement of matter in an ecosystem is best described as
A) a straight line that ends
B) a cycle that repeats
C) a one-time event
D) random

steps: Matter returns to the environment and is reused, forming a cycle.

items.prompt:
What do decomposers return to the environment?
A) Matter for plants to use again
B) Sunlight
C) New animals
D) Nothing
items.answer: A) Matter for plants to use again

steps: Decomposers return matter to the soil, air, and water.

items.prompt:
In the cycle environment to plant to ___ to decomposers, the blank is
A) animal
B) cloud
C) rock
D) Sun

steps: Animals eat plants, then decomposers break down the animals.

items.prompt:
If all decomposers disappeared, what would most likely happen?
A) Nothing would change
B) Dead material would pile up and matter would not return to the soil
C) Plants would grow faster
D) The Sun would dim
items.answer: B) Dead material would pile up and matter would not return to the soil

steps: Without decomposers the cycle breaks and matter stays locked in dead material.

items.prompt:
A model shows arrows only going one way with no return to the environment. The model is missing
A) the Sun
B) decomposers returning matter to the environment
C) more animals
D) nothing
items.answer: B) decomposers returning matter to the environment

steps: A complete cycle needs decomposers to return matter to the environment.
